proof.native_title: Physiological changes and symptoms associated with short-term exposure to electromagnetic fields: a randomized crossover provocation study

candidate_claims.text: The actual-exposure comparison did not identify an adverse symptom or physiological pattern under the tested conditions. Initially correct exposure guesses did not persist on repeat testing.
